User: I like the way it's cooked. It has a little sauce on it. I'm not a big on sauce on my meat. I like to add sauce as I need it when I'm eating. I don't really care for it to be on my meat, but the way they cook the ribs are very tender, and it's just the way they cook it.
Agent: That sounds delicious. Do you have one more similar item you like from any chain, and how does it compare to your favorite Arby's brisket sandwich?
